# self-measuring-mcp

Deterministic, Ed25519-signed self-measurement for AI agents. Call `self_measure`
on your own metrics and receive a verifiable card (license, provenance / Art 50
marking, logging, oversight, openness) you can present to a CI gate,
marketplace, or insurer.

## Tools
- `self_measure(entity, metrics)` -> signed measurement card (winner-neutral,
  deterministic, no LLM judge)
- `list_tools()` -> the tool schema

## Key facts
- Ed25519-signed card via sovos-city Chain (verifiable; never faked when
  unsigned — it is labelled)
- Deterministic transparency predicates: license_declared, model_card_present,
  provenance_declared (Art 50), logs_retained (Art 12), oversight_enabled
  (Art 14), eval_open
- Drift detection vs prior signed state
- Lawful: measures what the caller provides (self-attested public metrics) or
  public artifacts; never a private/surprise scan. No ISO-17024/17065
  certification claim — "verified measurement credential."
